definitions.ask: Raise the macOS CI Test watchdog from 15 to 20 minutes so a slow runner cannot fail a passing suite?
definitions.why: The watchdog is repo-wide hang policy outside this phase; typical runs take 11-12 minutes

choices.label: Watchdog fires at 1200 s, inside the 25-minute step timeout; real hangs surface 5 min later
Watchdog stays at 900 s; a slow runner can fail a passing run, which gets one rerun and a note
